description: For a whole home already booked (watch_booking, then the first morning's read found the nights taken by the traveller): watches other verified whole homes nearby for the same dates and party, and emails the account when one comes in at least 5% or $50 under what they paid, until their free-cancellation deadline. A find is always a different home, never the same one cheaper; the traveller books the new one first and cancels theirs second. Starts with one live search now (30 to 90 seconds; not counted as a trip). Needs the key the booking was watched with; free.
name: watch_similar_homes
title: Watch other whole homes for a booked stay's dates
